simple.meaning: קְבַל (qᵉbal) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to acquire.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:6. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְבַל (H6902) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קְבַל (qᵉbal) / H6902 is traced through Daniel 2:6, Daniel 6:1, Daniel 7:18 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive of me gifts and rewards and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”
